# Cards Grid

## Summary
Base-realm grid-of-cards card: an instance renders the realm's cards as a
filterable fitted-card grid — the classic workspace index experience. Lives
at `https://cardstack.com/base/cards-grid` (named export `CardsGrid`).

## Usage
Create a `CardsGrid` instance anywhere in a realm; it queries and renders
the realm's card instances with type filtering, no configuration required.

The linked example is a live grid over this very realm.
